_tgStart:
Hi, I'm Baymax, an AI bot with many useful features.

Guide: /help

Support: /support
_tgHelp:
To use the bot, you must first read and accept the terms and conditions. Then, authenticate by sending your Telegram account phone number.

After reading the rules and authentication, you can send your message and start using the bot.

Chat: To send a message to the AI, you must create a chat in the bot (a hidden chat is created by default). Select the chat to continue the conversation.
Your input can be text or a Telegram voice message.

Model: ChatGPT has different types (models) suitable for various tasks, each with different costs.

Message storage and memory: If you want the AI to remember your previous messages, enable the 'Save Messages' option in the user panel. Activating this feature will store your messages in the AI's memory. Note that using this feature significantly increases point consumption!

You can also process images, PDFs, and text/code files by replying to them.
_termsOfService:
• Privacy: Your personal information, including Telegram username, phone number, and sent messages, is confidential and will not be sold or misused.

• Transparency: There is no hidden fraud or limitation in using the AI service.

• Content responsibility: Responsibility for content generated by this service and AI is shared between the user (who requests the content) and the provider of the selected model (e.g., OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google, etc.).

• Ethical rules: Avoid using offensive language or inappropriate content.

• Reporting issues: If you encounter any bugs or malfunctions, please notify us. Exploiting bugs will result in a permanent account ban.

• Usage policy: To keep services sustainable and prioritize users in Iran, daily free points are exclusively available to accounts registered with an Iranian phone number.
